findings.description: AWS access credentials are embedded directly in Lambda environment variables. They will be stored in Terraform state and can be retrieved by principals able to view the function configuration, creating a credential-exposure risk.
The function uses the end-of-life Node.js 12.x runtime, which no longer receives security updates and increases exposure to known runtime vulnerabilities.
